Stellar Civilization Longevity System. Plans infrastructure, archives, energy systems, and maintenance strategies over astronomical timescales.

This database covers the technology as item 214 entry 30 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (A)" catalog, section "Stellar Engineering". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: unresolved. Long-term planning is standard; astronomical-timescale engineering has no precedent.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Stellar Civilization Longevity System - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Plans infrastructure, archives, energy systems, and maintenance strategies over astronomical timescales.
body:
Known science foundations of Stellar Civilization Longevity System.

Civil engineering designs for centuries (e.g., 10,000-year Clock of the Long Now). Nuclear-waste markers plan for 10,000 years. Astronomical timescales (millions+ years) exceed every institution. The system is a planning framework, not an engineering program.

Key quantity check (Longest continuously operating institution in years / target in years): computed ratio 0.001 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.4. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Stellar Civilization Longevity System - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Plans infrastructure, archives, energy systems, and maintenance strategies over astronomical timescales.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Stellar Civilization Longevity System.

No institution lasts millennia. Technology and needs change unpredictably. Maintenance over Myr is unplannable in detail.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 5 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is target vs plans published at 5 orders of magnitude (target larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
